name: Atrium
tagline: Client portal for agencies and freelancers
description: Client portal for agencies and freelancers. Share project progress, files, tasks and invoices through a branded portal. Source: https://github.com/Vibra-Labs/Atrium

env.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
env.label: Auth secret, min 32 chars — generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

env.name: WEB_URL
env.label: Public URL the portal is served from — email invite and reset links are built from this

env.name: API_URL
env.label: Public API URL — same value, the image serves app and API from one origin

env.name: SECURE_COOKIES
env.label: Secure cookies — set to false when serving over plain HTTP

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.label: External PostgreSQL URL (optional, blank uses the built-in database)

env.name: STORAGE_PROVIDER
env.label: Storage provider: local, s3, minio or r2

env.name: RESEND_API_KEY
env.label: Resend API key (optional, enables invite and reset emails)
